rules.statement: A Muslim wife who wants to obtain a divorce from her husband without his consent has the option of filing an action in the District Court or going before the Kathi Court, depending on whether the case falls within the definition of Fasah Divorce.
rules.supporting_quote: "Today a Muslim wife who wants to obtain a divorce from her husband without his consent has to decide whether she has to go before the Kathi Court or whether she could file her action in the District Court. These are matters for the Legislature."
